'Golden Handshake' = Voluntary Retirement Scheme is a recurring keyword trap.
Old-to-new regime (SICA/BIFR/AAIFR to IBC/NCLT/NCLAT) is the likely modern angle.
App MCQs go well beyond PYQ depth (SICA definition tests, committee matches, RBI SMA categories) and use multi-statement formats.
